title: Nafasi ya Pambizo katika Uandishi (Theme 4: Kazi mbalimbali)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child marks the margin first, writes inside it with spaces between words, and starts a new aya for each new idea.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a sentence with spaces between words.
floor.question: Andika: Mama anapika.

representations: a page with the margin coloured
a model passage with two aya
syllable claps for a long word
steps: Start a new aya for the next idea.
contexts: a short letter to a friend

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes two aya about the theme inside the margin.

misconceptions.repair: Sentensi za wazo moja hukaa pamoja katika aya moja.

misconceptions.ask: Silabi za neno hili ni zipi?
misconceptions.repair: Gawa neno kati ya silabi na uweke kistari.
